entities.summary: Virgin Lands, a notable figure in the history of Kazakhstan, associated with Soviet Kazakhstan (1934–1970). Preceded by Industrialization and Nuclear Testing and Collectivization famine (Asharshylyk) kills approximately 1.5 million Kazakhs. Their legacy influenced Yuri Gagarin launches into space from Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan and Jeltoqsan and Late Soviet Period.
